harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

munchkin-d6.description: munchkin start, stair-scum target depth 6 (the depth borg.txt's comment describes)

rs-c.label: borg-rs harness, C Borg (pristine C Borg under the borgh frontend)

rs-rust.label: borg-rs: the Rust port of the C Borg (faithful, C bugs kept)

smoke.description: better-borg-c frozen cohort v1: 3 seeds, 20,000 engine turns

experiment.description: borg-rs on the zoo: the Rust Borg against the C Borg built in the same borg-rs tree (a key-for-key identity check at zoo scale), with the better-borg-c observer's pristine run alongside for the distributions. Runs from different harnesses are not paired: the same seed does not give the same game under a different frontend and birth script.
experiment.name: rs-smoke
